name: quote-platform-backend
description: Backend API for the quoting platform

scripts.db:migrate: sh -c 'for f in db/migrations/*.sql; do echo "Applying $f"; docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U quote -d quote_platform -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f - < "$f" || exit 1; done'
scripts.db:migrate:file: sh -c 'docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U quote -d quote_platform -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f - < "$1"' --
